summary: Millrose Properties furnished an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing pricing of a previously announced private offering of $1.0 billion aggregate principal senior notes in two tranches: $500 million of 6.500% notes due 2029 and $500 million of 6.750% notes due 2031, priced at 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest from October 6, 2026. Sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S to qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. persons, the offering is expected to close October 6, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine private debt capital raise, not a special situation.
